description:
Undo, redo and revisit earlier decisions in a single-player run.

[h2]Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*]Undo and redo actions or turns
[*]Load earlier rooms and floors
[*]Restart the room, repeat the seed or start with a random seed
[/list]

[h2]Interface[/h2]
Movable toolbar and resizable history, with card and potion previews. Shortcuts and components are configurable in the mod settings.

Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3737335127]BaseLib[/url].
